data_fields.name: idle_max_life
data_fields.donor_constant: 60 * 60 * 24 * 7 (604800), measured from last new room in donor (fix: any traversal)

best_idea: A party that enters a zone through the same portal before its next reset shares one instance, and the instance is dropped after an idle limit that every traversal refreshes, with every member sent back to the hub.
decision_why: Frankendom needs per-party zone instances and this gives the sentinel-portal and idle-collapse shape; the donor defects (idle clock measured from new rooms, untagged followers, rooms never released, budget overshoot, clear gate with no caller) must be fixed first, and the instance must be server-owned on one runtime.
acceptance: A server test where three players enter the same portal in one window and share one instance; a fourth player entering after a reset gets a new instance; after the idle limit with no traversal all members are back at the hub and no room of that instance remains.
